Her figure is divided into 5 concentric regions around a single centre point located at the middle of her bust, about 27% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 4 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 14%, 34%, 58% and 80% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Her bust carries a small round disc of iridescent pearl on each breast, about the size of her areola, fully opaque and covering her nipple and areola, shimmering in soft pink, mint and lilac with a luminous nacre gloss, sitting flat on the surface of the breast. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries thick impasto oil paint with heavy palette-knife ridges. Region 4 is the ring between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries traditional Japanese irezumi tattoo art with peonies, waves and clouds. Region 5 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries Mondrian style grid of thick lines and flat blocks. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, perfectly circular course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle.
